blocks.text: The Lenovo V14 Gen 4 is designed for everyday work, mobility and a seamless computing experience. Powered by the latest Intel Core i7-13620H processor, it’s designed to provide improved work experience, reliable computing, and responsiveness. The Integrated Intel® UHD graphics fuel sharper visuals and for enhanced content creation. Plus, it's future proof with extra slots for memory (for up to 16GB of total memory) and storage (2.5" HDD up to 1TB). The wide range of port options helps you expand your devices' potential and access multiple peripherals. The USB Type-C handles data transfer, HDMI delivers audio, and video, and USB 3.2 connect to accessories. An RJ45 port enables high-speed internet from home or office networks while Bluetooth 5.2 ensures easy accessory connectivity. Be at your professional best in your Microsoft Teams meetings and video conferencing with Lenovo Smart Appearance. Intelligent noise cancelation reduces distractions while the HD camera and dual speakers enhanced with Dolby Audio® relay what matters with perfect clarity. When you’re done with your video conference, just close the Camera Privacy Shutter and render your webcam hacker-proof. The durable chassis paired with a Kensington™ NanoSaver™ Lock help you bring your work everywhere worry-free. Windows 11 Home comes with cutting-edge features that help protect you from malware and protect your identity by using advanced security methods for logging into your device. Software-based TPM 2.0 defends against ransomware, distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks, and data breaches, while multifactor authentication verifies user identity. The Lenovo V14 Gen 4’s convenience features and conferencing enhancements let business professionals perform at their best every day.

items: A RELIABLE COMPANION WHEREVER YOU NEED ONE – Whether in the board room, airport, or office, the Lenovo V14 Gen 4 is built for powerful and secure performance. With ample battery life and the latest connectivity features, it can match your pace for all-day productivity.

TAP INTO IMPROVED EVERYDAY PERFORMANCE – The Intel Core i7-13620H processor delivers powerful multitasking balanced by efficient offloading of background tasks for improved performance and productivity.
FUTURE-PROOF – Boost your computing power when and where you need it. Easily install an extra 8GB for up to 16GB total memory and up to 1TB HDD in the 2nd storage slot. Your future will thank you.
CLEAR AND COMFORTABLE VIEWING – Utilize every inch of the 14” display with 88% screen-to-body ratio, wide viewing angles, and FHD quality visuals to render everything crystal-clear.

SEAMLESS AND SAFE COLLABORATION – Put your best foot forward in Microsoft Teams with Lenovo Smart Appearance. It reduces distractions and enhances the meetings with smart camera effects to protect your privacy and improve your appearance.
PERFORMANCE USERS CAN TRUST – The Integrated Intel UHD graphics fuel easy multitasking, speedy performance, and an enhanced entertainment experience.

MULTIFACETED SECURITY – Secure your work with OS-level security that defends against ransomware, data breaches, and identity theft. The Kensington NanoSaver Lock and camera’s privacy shutter provide physical protection for added security.
INCREASED FUNCTIONALITY – The RJ45 port enables high-speed internet anywhere while Wi-Fi 6 enhances wireless connectivity for traffic-free online experiences.
